description: Capture a screenshot of THIS computer, the one the AttachDesk app and this server run on, and return it inline as an image. To see the computer you are connected to, use jrd_remote_screenshot instead. Default JPEG at quality 85, max width 1600, which keeps the payload small enough for MCP transports.

format.description: Output format. JPEG is ~10x smaller for desktop content.

max_width.description: Optional max width in pixels. Image is downscaled preserving aspect ratio. Default 1600 to keep MCP payloads manageable.

name: jrd_screenshot
